title: Versioned migration runner for 26 registries + state JSONs
brief: Every state JSON requires schemaVersion per CLAUDE.md but there is no migration runner for breaking changes across 26 registries. Risk: schema bumps without migration silently corrupt. This MS builds the runner + N-1 compat enforcement.

units.title: MigrationRunnerEngine: discover, plan, apply, rollback
exit_conditions: engine reads src/migrations/ for ordered N -> N+1 transforms
plan output: targets[], current vs target version
units.description: Per CLAUDE.md migrations live in src/migrations/. Engine orchestrates apply + rollback.

units.title: Stage 1 breaking-change migration (proof of life)
exit_conditions: 1 staged migration ships (e.g. add fk to InsertRegistry pointing at HolderRegistry)
round-trip: pre-migration JSON -> post-migration JSON -> rollback -> byte-identical
tests: corrupted source JSON -> migration aborts cleanly
units.description: Real migration to validate the runner. Use the new registries from MS0a as the test bed.

units.title: CI gate: block merges that bump schemaVersion without migration
exit_conditions: pre-commit hook checks: any schemaVersion bump must have matching src/migrations/<from>-><to>.ts
test: PR that bumps version without migration is blocked
units.description: Hook integration. Reuses existing PreCommit infra.

acceptance: migration runner upgrades N-1 schemas with rollback path; tested on 1 staged breaking-change migration; CI gate blocks unmigrated schemaVersion bumps.

risks.description: Migration on live state JSON during a running session corrupts in-flight work; mitigation = Stop-hook quiesce + lock-all-claims gate before run
